|- forall P.
       P {} /\
       (forall s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s UNION t)) /\
       (forall s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s DIFF t))
       ==> (forall s.
                (forall n. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (s n))
                ==> (exists t.
                         (forall n. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (t n)) /\
                         (forall n. t n SUBSET s n) /\
                         pairwise (\m n. DISJOINT (t m) (t n)) (:num) /\
                         UNIONS {t n | n IN (:num)} =
                         UNIONS {s n | n IN (:num)}))
forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ ((forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) /\ (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\: t))) -> forall s :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s n) -> exists t :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, t n c= s n) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> t x :/\: t y = Empty) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))

GENERAL_REDUCTION_THEOREM_2
:0
f5e0fb736c2f
|- forall P.
       P {} /\
       (forall s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s UNION t)) /\
       (forall s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s DIFF t))
       ==> (forall s t.
                (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s /\ (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) t
                ==> (exists s' t'.
                         (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s' /\
                         (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) t' /\
                         s' SUBSET s /\
                         t' SUBSET t /\
                         DISJOINT s' t' /\
                         s' UNION t' = s UNION t))
